summary: The home is bought some years after the marriage, not at once.
realLife: The same couple bought their home about four years after marrying.
sources: Texas State Historical Association Handbook of Texas, Maria Angela Socorro Grijalva Acosta (summarizing a 1982 UTEP oral history): https://www.tshaonline.org/handbook/entries/acosta-maria-angela-socorro-grijalva-lucy

turns.pulledBy: the purchase date precedes the partnership
turns.writesBack: the line says the home came first
